svg.title: MarginMaestro Functional Architecture
svg.text: What happens, in what order, and who answers for it — one margin-call lifecycle, end to end
① Detect & Evaluate — code computes every number
② Decide — a human approves every call
③ Notify — client on WhatsApp, desk on Slack
④ Respond & Escalate — SLA timer, then ServiceNow
⑤ Transparency, Always — every step logged and reportable
• A call never fires without human approval
• Elite-tier counterparties need a second signature
• Every notice carries real figures, computed by code
• The client sees the firm's own CSA terms, cited
• A missed SLA escalates automatically — no one has to notice
• Every step is logged, traced, and reportable
Icons: the real product where one is used (WhatsApp, Slack,
ServiceNow, Gemini, Firebase); a generic glyph otherwise.
